issue: Step 42B-2 multiscale verification included the source video filename in the model-visible candidate payload.
risk: Development filenames contain semantic labels such as defect_12_drywall_patch_baseboard and clean_29_quimby_vanity_level_holder.
A model seeing those names may infer whether a clip is expected to contain a defect and may infer the expected defect type.
Therefore the original 42B-2 verification cannot be considered fully annotation-blind even though annotation JSON content was not supplied.
unaffected_evidence: 42B-1 raw multi-keyframe candidate generation did not use annotation content.
42B-3 and 42B-4A diagnostic scripts explicitly avoided supplying clip names to the model where documented.
Frozen Detector v2 source integrity is unaffected.
correction_plan: Do not modify the historical 42B-2 artifact in place.
Create a corrected label-blind verifier that never sends video paths, filenames, stems, annotation text, or expected labels to the model.
Replay the same six saved 42B-1 raw observations through the corrected verifier.
Compare corrected decisions with the prior 42B-2 decisions.
Use only the corrected verifier in the full 42B-4A candidate.
